ns2:section.sectionText: If this section is full send your name, UIN, class (fr, sp, jr, sn) to hammack@netbox.com to be put on a waiting list. This section is reserved for Sophomore students in the College of LAS. Any exceptions to this must be approved in writing by Professor Hammack (hammack@netbox.com). Any exceptions that are not approved by him, errors in admittance, or overrides that violate the selection criteria for this section will be corrected before the semester starts. Note that all sections of this course meet at the same time.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Liberal Arts & Sciences. Not intended for Chemical Engineering major(s). Restricted to students with Sophomore class standing.
